method: Daily original values are retained verbatim. Water-volume fractions sum original numeric daily mean discharge. Estimated and approved flags can coexist. A nonnumeric agency value remains in the source inspector and CSV; it creates a plot gap. Annual volumes require every calendar day to be numeric. The added 13-gauge reference uses only fully approved complete years, as specified by its retained source; the original 16-gauge reference preserves its original complete-year rule.
